verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਲਹਿਰ ਤਰੰਗ ਅਤੋਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: sukh saagar hai saadhasa(n)g sobhaa lahir tara(n)g atole|

en.bdb: Holy congregation is that ocean of delight in which the waves of Lord’s praise adorn it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਣਕ ਮੋਤੀ ਹੀਰਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਅਵੇਸੁ ਅਮੋਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: maanak motee heeriaa gur upadhes aves amole|

en.bdb: Myriad rubies diamonds and pearls in the form of Guru’s teachings exist in this ocean.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗ ਰਤਨ ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਅਗਮ ਅਲੋਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: raag ratan anahadh dhunee sabadh surat liv agam alole|

en.bdb: Musicality here is like a jewel and merging their consciousness in the rhythm of the unstruck Word, the listeners listen to it with rapt attention.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਸਭ ਗੋਲੀਆਂ ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਗੋਇਲ ਗੋਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: ridh sidh nidh sabh goleeaa(n) chaar padhaarath goil gole|

en.bdb: Here the miraculous powers are subservient and the four ideals of life (dharm, arth, kam and moks) are servants and being transitory does not attract the attention of the people who reached this stage.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਲਖ ਚੰਦ ਚਰਾਗ਼ਚੀ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪੀਚਨਿ ਝੋਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: lakh lakh cha(n)dh charaag(h)chee lakh lakh a(n)mirat peechan jhole|

en.bdb: Myriad means here work as lamps and myriad men getting elated quaff the nectar.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਧੇਨੁ ਲਖ ਪਾਰਿਜਾਤ ਜੰਗਲ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਚਰਨਿ ਅਡੋਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: kaamadhen lakh paarijaat ja(n)gal a(n)dhar charan addole|

en.bdb: Myriad of wish fulfilling cows gaze delightfully in the forest of wish fulfilling trees.
In fact the pleasure fruit of the gurmukhs is ineffable.
